description: Query event marketing analytics. Supports dimensions, metrics, time ranges, and filters across campaigns, purchases, fans (user_tenants), and more. MANDATORY RULES: (1) ALWAYS call nevent_analytics_table_schema BEFORE querying to discover exact field names. NEVER guess field names. (2) For BOOLEAN fields, use operator "eq" (or "neq") with the boolean value true or false; "is_true"/"is_false" are segmentation operators and analytics rejects them. (3) For enum fields (state, status), check the field description for valid values. Common values: purchases.state = SUCCEEDED|COMPLETE|PENDING|FAILED; campaigns.status = EXECUTED|DRAFT|PAUSED|STOPPED.

dimensions.description: Dimension values to compare against each other

name.description: Display name for the comparison group

previous.description: The baseline (previous) time period to compare against

dimensions.description: Dimensions to select in the CTE

filters.description: Filters to apply in the CTE

metrics.description: Metrics to compute in the CTE

name.description: Name used to reference this CTE via the sourceTable field

timeRange.description: Time range filter for the CTE

dimensions.description: Fields to group by (SELECT dimensions). Omit for aggregate-only queries.

alias.description: Alias for the column in results

distinct.description: Add SELECT DISTINCT to deduplicate result rows (v3.19.0+)

dryRun.description: Dry-run mode: estimate query cost without executing (v3.19.0+). Response includes estimatedBytes in metadata.

filters.description: WHERE clause filters to apply before aggregation

operator.description: Comparison operator. Valid values depend on the field type (nevent_analytics_capabilities lists them): eq | neq | gt | gte | lt | lte | in | nin | contains | not_contains | starts_with | ends_with | regex | regex_i | before | after | between | in_range | not_in_range | is_empty | is_not_empty | exists. BOOLEAN fields: eq or neq with true/false.

value.description: Filter value; use array for "in" / "not_in" / "between" operators

groupBy.description: Calendar-based group-by fields (v3.19.0+). Known values: dayOfWeek | weekOfYear | hourOfDay | minuteOfHour | month | quarter | year

having.description: HAVING clause filters to apply after aggregation

metrics.description: Aggregated metrics to compute (SUM, COUNT, etc.)

alias.description: Alias for the aggregated column in results

operation.description: Aggregation function. Known values: sum | count | avg | min | max | count_distinct | median | percentile | stddev | variance | date_diff

sort.description: Sort the result rows. Accepts a single { field, order } object or an array for multi-field sorting.

sourceTable.description: CTE name to use as source instead of a raw collection — v3.19.0+

timeGranularity.description: Time granularity for bucketing (v3.19.0+). Known values: day | week | month | quarter | year | hour | minute | fiscalQuarter | fiscalYear

timeRange.description: Time range filter with optional granularity for trend analysis

end.description: End date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2024-12-31"

granularity.description: Time bucket granularity (deprecated: use top-level timeGranularity)

start.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

name: nevent_analytics_query
